---
title: "Sri Lanka Country String Diagnostic"
output: html_document
---

```{r check}
library(sparklyr)
library(dplyr)
library(dbplyr)

sc <- spark_connect(method = "databricks")

global_tbl <- tbl(sc, in_catalog("era5-daily-data", "silver_dev",
  "aer_era5_silver_approximate_1950_to_present_dev_interpolation_res5"))

# Get exact country string
lk_countries <- global_tbl %>%
  filter(country %like% "%Lanka%") %>%
  select(country) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  collect()

# Get sample rows with year/month from time
lk_sample <- global_tbl %>%
  filter(country %like% "%Lanka%") %>%
  mutate(yr = year(time), mo = month(time)) %>%
  filter(yr >= 1973, yr <= 1973) %>%
  select(longitude, latitude, country, time, yr, mo, sum_tp_mm, mean_t2m_c) %>%
  head(5) %>%
  collect()

# Row count for app time range
lk_rows <- global_tbl %>%
  filter(country %like% "%Lanka%",
         year(time) >= 1973,
         year(time) <= 2023) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), n_pixels = n_distinct(longitude, latitude)) %>%
  collect()

results <- list(
  exact_country_string = lk_countries,
  sample_rows = lk_sample,
  row_count_1973_2023 = lk_rows
)
saveRDS(results, "/Volumes/projects/gwsc_drought/drought_outputs/diag_sri_lanka.rds")

cat("Exact country string:\n"); print(lk_countries)
cat("\nSample rows:\n"); print(lk_sample)
cat("\nRow count 1973-2023:\n"); print(lk_rows)

spark_disconnect(sc)
```
